title: GAO Urges Pentagon to Fix Responsible AI Council, Staffing
key_facts: The Government Accountability Office (GAO) recommended that the Department of War (the Pentagon) formalise its responsible AI coordination body and fill staffing gaps in the Chief Digital and AI Office (CDAO).
The department concurred with both recommendations, GAO said on Wednesday 14 Oct 2026.
The council stopped meeting in late 2024 and did not resume until August 2025; four components reported implementation problems during the gap.
Only three of the Responsible AI Division's 10 authorised positions were filled as of February 2026.
GAO recommended the CDAO issue a charter assigning duties and a meeting schedule, and address the division's staffing.
GAO also asked lawmakers to consider directing the Pentagon to act on two older open recommendations on AI collaboration and workforce planning.
The department's 2026 AI strategy prioritises speed; GAO surveyed 10 components on 10 use cases.
quote_evidence: The Government Accountability Office has recommended that the Department of War formalize its responsible artificial intelligence coordination body and fill staffing gaps in the Chief Digital and AI Office.
Officials said just three of the division's 10 authorized positions were occupied as of February 2026.
why_it_matters_hint: Gaps in oversight and staff could slow the Pentagon's AI adoption.
